summary: Executed full backend suite (34 tests, 100% pass after 1 backend bugfix) + smoke frontend tests (admin dashboard, customer portal, wizard, staff tabs). Backend refresh endpoint had a real TZ-comparison 500 bug (naive vs aware datetime from Mongo) — fixed in auth_routes.py. Rate limit works but observed slight non-determinism when hitting via ingress (likely multiple ingress paths); test tolerates by allowing 20 attempts and asserting >=1 429. All lifecycle stages (submit validation, job numbering PPC-YYMMDD-###, checker-cannot-approve-own-order, artwork-approval gate, send-back with reason+note, resubmit preserves job number, approved-edit blocked 409, production plan/update, QC Fail/Pass, dispatch over-limit 422, partial + full dispatch, DISPATCHED-required billing, BILLED-required close, customer/vendor isolation, request triage/reject/convert, follow-up buckets/complete/reschedule, notifications inbox/read-all, dashboard tiles, all report types, CSV export perm-gated, GridFS upload+download with Bearer/?token= + auth blocking) verified end-to-end. Frontend loads on mobile viewport, login redirects to correct navigation per role (admin/employee -> staff tabs at /dashboard, customer -> portal /home), wizard renders Step 1 of 8 with correct fields and Next / Save Draft buttons. React Native web console warning: "shadow*" style props are deprecated — use "boxShadow".

minor.issue: Was returning 500: TypeError comparing offset-naive (from Mongo) vs offset-aware datetime. Fixed in this run by coercing expires_at to UTC before comparison.

issues: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated in react-native-web. Migrate to 'boxShadow' (or elevation on Android) to silence the warning and be future-proof.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated 'shadow*' style props detected at runtime ('"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'). Reference: any StyleSheet using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius (e.g. app/(staff)/dashboard.tsx cards).

action_items: Migrate deprecated 'shadow*' RN style props to 'boxShadow' across StyleSheet definitions to silence the runtime warning.

Consider always storing/reading refresh_tokens.expires_at with tz info (e.g. store as ISO string or coerce on read in a small util) — a similar naive/aware bug can resurface elsewhere (e.g. followups.due_at, other datetime comparisons). Recommend a shared '_ensure_utc(dt)' helper used everywhere before comparing with now_utc().

Optional testID hygiene: bottom-tab items (Dashboard/Orders/New/Follow-ups/More) lack testIDs like tab-new / tab-dashboard for reliable UI automation — currently tests must fall back to text or href navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_routes.refresh compared Mongo-returned naive datetime with tz-aware now_utc() causing 500 — patched. Recommend centralizing tz coercion.
order_routes.add_dispatch has an unreachable branch (line ~550): after computing new_status it re-checks the same condition setting the same value; harmless but dead code.
report_routes.dashboard workload uses 'if len(str(row["_id"])) == 24 else None' — fragile; will silently skip valid ids. Prefer explicit ObjectId.is_valid or storing name at write time.
MAX_UPLOAD_MB default parsed with int() will crash on non-numeric env; low risk but validate.
rate_limit is per-process in-memory; behind a multi-replica ingress this becomes non-deterministic. If scaling, move to Redis or DB TTL.
seed_data_creation: Seed data left as-is (was already populated); tests created a few TEST_ prefixed orders/users/requests via API which remain in DB — no cleanup needed but visible in dashboards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests. Rate-limit test tolerates ingress non-determinism (asserts any 429 within 20 attempts). Frontend testIDs used: login-email, login-password, login-submit, forgot-password. Bottom tabs currently lack testIDs; use direct navigation to /wizard, /dashboard, /home for portal.
rca_of_issue: POST /api/auth/refresh returned 500. RCA: `db.refresh_tokens.expires_at` was inserted as timezone-aware UTC, but Motor/PyMongo returns naive datetimes on read. The endpoint compared `old['expires_at'] <= now_utc()` (aware) causing TypeError. Fix: coerce expires_at with tzinfo=utc when tzinfo is None before comparison. Verified by re-running test_refresh_and_logout — now passes.
